source_text: Plura nobis simul recitata sunt. Moyses exiit ad populum et locutus est verba Domini. Doctor ecclesiae intus est cum profunda Dei sapientiae inter perfectos loquitur; foras exit cum ad turbas profert quae vulgus audire potest. Paulus sapientiam inter perfectos loquebatur. Dominus septuaginta seniores elegit; spiritum qui in Moyse erat posuit super eos. Non materialem spiritum intelligas, sed spiritum sanctum in sanctis.
pass_a_gloss: Many-things to-us at-once recited are. Moses went-out to people and spoke words of-Lord. Teacher of-church within is when deep-things of-God of-wisdom among perfect he-speaks; outside he-goes when to crowds he-brings-forth what common-folk to-hear is-able. Paul wisdom among perfect was-speaking. Lord seventy elders chose; spirit which in Moses was he-placed upon them. Not material spirit you-should-understand, but spirit holy in holy-ones.
pass_b_english: Many things were read to us at once. [[Moses went out to the people and spoke the words of the Lord >> Bible:Numbers 11:24]]. A church teacher is “within” while he speaks God’s deep wisdom among the perfect; he “goes outside” when he offers the crowds what the multitude can hear. So Paul [[spoke wisdom among the perfect >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:6]]. The Lord chose seventy elders and [[put the spirit that was on Moses upon them >> Bible:Numbers 11:16-25]]. Do not take “spirit” as a material stuff, but as the Holy Spirit in the holy.
